description: Agent Construction: submit a contractor license record with the bid or contract as presented: the license record with its issuer, license number, holder, each classification it shows, its status (active, inactive, expired, suspended or revoked), the days issued and expiring and the day the record was read; the document with its kind (a bid or a contract), the contractor it names, the license number it prints, the classification it states for the work, its date and the day the work it covers is to end. The signed report gives the license record and the document, the license number and the holder on each side read as matching or differing, the classification read as held or unheld, and the license’s standing on the document date, and counts them, and names a discrepant license: a license number or holder unlike the license record, a classification the license does not hold, a license the record shows inactive, expired, suspended or revoked, and a license expired before or issued after the document date; then a license that expires before the work ends and a record read before the document date, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No license number, holder, classification, status or expiry leaves the license unverified. License numbers match by their letters and digits, holders without a legal suffix such as LLC or Inc, and classifications by the code they lead with, so B and B - General Building read as one. This reads a contractor’s license against the project documents it qualifies for: wever_license-evidence-check reads a software or content license text for the license family its marker phrases match and its obligations, for DiligenceOps, and wever_vendor-identity-check reads a vendor’s registration number among its identity evidence, while the license check reads a contractor license record’s number, holder, classification and expiry against the bid or contract. Verdict build_license_discrepant, build_license_partial, build_license_unverified or build_license_matched. POST /api/build-license-check. Reads the construction paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no structural, engineering or safety judgment, building-code compliance determination, valuation of work performed or legal advice on contracts, liens or permits, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Construction reads supplied construction paperwork for consistency between documents: a building permit, a contractor license record, a bid, a construction contract, a change order, a lien waiver, a completion certificate or punch list record, and a payment application. Beside it, wever_workorder-create and the other wever_workorder tools and wever_agent-work-order-exchange are the action layer that creates, funds, delivers and releases work orders, while this family moves nothing and executes nothing and only reads paperwork; wever_agent-escrow-lite holds and releases escrowed funds, and escrow stays there; and the Agent Real Estate checks such as wever_realty-title-check read property records by parcel and address, not a project’s construction paperwork. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-construction-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-construction/.

classification.description: The classification the document states for the work.

kind.description: Whether the document is a bid or a contract.

work_ends_on.description: The day the work the document covers is to end, such as 2026-06-12.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

as_of.description: The day the record was read, such as 2026-06-12.

classifications.description: Each classification the license record shows.

status.description: The status the license record shows.
